programmes.d: Twenty-seven-year-old Egypt Covington is found murdered in her home; investigators in Michigan quickly identify a person of interest, but years pass without an arrest.
Private investigator and former police officer Taylor Wright vanishes, but detectives think there is more to the story after her girlfriend receives strange text messages from Taylor's phone.

Eleven years after Connecticut mother Donna Palomba is raped in her home, investigators finally track down her attacker; Donna speaks out about the latest developments in the case, including her fight to keep her assailant from walking free.
When a University of Utah athlete is found murdered on campus, investigators learn that she had reached out to the campus police for help multiple times before her death.
A woman continues searching for answers after the investigation into her daughter's murder goes cold.
The murder of a young schoolteacher in Pennsylvania goes unsolved for years, but investigators discover a new tool that may finally help unlock the murderer's identity.
As detectives investigate a mother of two's sudden disappearance, her friends and family reveal she feared she was being stalked.
When Susan Woods doesn't show up for work, she is soon discovered dead in her bathtub; as police search for answers, they find a trail of victims.
After an apparent home invasion in Minnesota leaves Heidi Firkus dead and her husband, Nick, hospitalized, detectives learn the young couple was facing financial troubles.
The disappearance of a 20-year-old honors student causes her family to fear the worst; decades later, the mystery is solved.
A 29-year-old woman goes missing.
A man uses a dating site to meet and murder a college student.
Detectives find a message written in blood during a murder investigation.

When 18-year-old Anjelica "AJ" Hadsell disappears, the investigation into her inner circle reveals a sinister betrayal; featuring interviews with AJ's stepfather Wesley Hadsell and two of her friends.
An Idaho man is sentenced to life after falsely confessing to his friend's murder; but after the true culprit is caught and the case seemingly closed, a chilling twist unfolds.
When a pharmacist is found shot to death in his Wisconsin farmhouse, investigators embark on a 15-year hunt for his elusive killer.
A mother is found dead in a house fire, but an autopsy reveals a brutal murder; the case goes cold for years until a shocking confession is made.
An investigation into the poisoning of Wisconsin mother-of-two Julie Jensen takes a surprising turn when detectives learn that she wrote a letter days before her death pointing to a possible suspect.
A woman seeks justice for her 18-year-old daughter, who was raped and murdered in an Anchorage state park in 1994.
A pregnant woman vanishes before her own baby shower and her worried family raises the alarm; detectives unravel a chilling mystery.
A mother searches for answers in the unsolved murder of her 14-year-old daughter until new DNA technology changes everything.

The missing-persons case of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews in Colorado remained a mystery for more than three decades until detectives narrowed in on a suspect whose bizarre behavior after her disappearance hinted at something much more sinister.
